name: Princess Party
original_name: Princess Party ～プリンセスパーティー～
source:
The main character has transferred to a new school. The atmosphere of the school is lively and cheerful. His happy school life has just begun.... But one day, the school buildings are suddenly destroyed and new school buildings like castles appear.... "This is my gift to you as a greeting." She also says, "No adolescence from today!"

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主人公转入一所新学校。校园气氛活泼而欢快，他幸福的校园生活刚刚开始……然而某天，校舍突然遭到摧毁，随后出现了如同城堡般的新校舍……“这是我送给你的见面礼。”她还说道：“从今天开始，不准青春！”

[摘自ErogeShop]
